The climate in Dobrinishte

Dobrinishte is about 840 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 27°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −4°C. Around 840 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in March (about 99 mm). The highest temperature in Dobrinishte in 2015–2024 was 35°C (2 August 2021) and the lowest −19°C (23 January 2016).

Dobrinishte lies at the foot of the Pirin mountains at about 850 m, some 6 km from Bansko. The Bezbog ski area is high up in the mountains, at about 2200 m, where the snow lasts longer, and the town has mineral springs.

Best time to visit Dobrinishte

The most pleasant weather in Dobrinishte is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 23°C and 27°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month. In January nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
